problems_addressed.specific_problem: Balancing multiple commitments and finding time to scale the business
problems_addressed.solution_summary: Evaluate current commitments and identify areas to reduce or eliminate to free up time for business growth.

problems_addressed.specific_problem: Feeling overwhelmed by the need to do everything perfectly
problems_addressed.solution_summary: Focus on authenticity and personal strengths rather than trying to fit into a prescribed mold.

target_avatars.key_takeaway: Identify and prioritize tasks that align with personal strengths and business goals.

episode_summary: In this episode, Michael Opyd coaches REALTOR David Farrell on how to scale his business by managing time and commitments effectively. They discuss the importance of authenticity, consistent follow-up, and reducing non-essential activities to focus on growth. The conversation provides insights into balancing personal goals with professional success.
